name: General Convergence
description: Runs the full-scope convergence loop, inserts optional focused workers, and hands merged findings directly to round summary and human review.

nodes.title: Scope contract
nodes.description: Freeze the repository snapshot, direct audit scope, exclusions, runtime configuration, and target identity.

nodes.title: Source context
nodes.description: Record the in-scope source inventory for auditors and reviewers without ranking, partitioning, or constraining the investigation.
nodes.prompt: Record the in-scope source files and declarations as navigation context only. Do not rank files or prescribe audit questions.

nodes.title: Independent general audit
nodes.description: Give every isolated worker the complete audit scope and let it independently identify the most important security questions.

nodes.title: Adaptive focus
nodes.description: Optionally insert narrow workers from prior merged evidence, summary gaps, or an explicit reviewer request without narrowing the general audit loop.
nodes.prompt: Investigate only the assigned evidence-driven objective. Falsify the premise when unsupported; otherwise return source-grounded evidence that materially changes the canonical record.

nodes.title: Canonical candidates
nodes.description: Consolidate overlapping findings, reconstruct useful signals against source, retain provenance, and prepare the round summary.
nodes.prompt: Normalize the workers' free-form audit reports into canonical findings. Preserve plausible low-confidence signals when the source supports them.

nodes.title: Human review
nodes.description: Require explicit reviewer decisions for validity, impact, duplicates, remediation, and risk acceptance.

nodes.title: Regression baseline
nodes.description: Compare stable root-cause fingerprints and evidence revisions across target-scoped runs.

nodes.title: Delivery package
nodes.description: Produce reviewer-approved reports, machine-readable exports, and remediation handoff artifacts.
